I am sorry - I have done the extra platforms runs before merging but I have missed this failure in the sea of other failures again.

> I am sorry - I have done the extra platforms runs before merging but I have missed this failure in the sea of other failures again.

I'm starting to doubt whether the extra-platforms leg is where NativeAOT testing should happen. These legs get _very red_ a lot. I opened #72419 to do something about this because it is a problem.

review_comments: `(this != CurrentThread)` path needs to have the same error handling and throw InvalidOperationException as the `(this == CurrentThread)` path.
This was incorrect assumption. COM initialization can fail with PlatformNotSupportedException on Nano server.
I think this should be `_startException = null;`
